an7.15:1.1: bhikkhave udakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an7.15:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo 'va hoti,
an7.15:1.4: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati,
an7.15:1.5: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti,
an7.15:1.6: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi,
an7.15:1.7: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patarati,
an7.15:1.8: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti,
an7.15:1.9: idha pana bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an7.15:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo 'va hoti? 3.
an7.15:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo samannāgato hoti ekantakāḷakehi akusalehi dhammehi.
an7.15:2.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sakiṃ nimuggo nimuggo 'va hoti.
an7.15:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati? 4.
an7.15:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:3.6: Tassa sā saddhā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati, hāyati yeva. Tassa sā hiri . . . pe . . .
an7.15:3.9: tassa sā paññā neva tiṭṭhati no vaḍḍhati, hāyati yeva.
an7.15:3.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā nimujjati.
an7.15:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti? 5.
an7.15:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:4.6: Tassa sā saddhā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati, ṭhitā hoti.
an7.15:4.10: tassa sā paññā neva hāyati no vaḍḍhati, ṭhitā hoti.
an7.15:4.11: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā ṭhito hoti.
an7.15:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi? 6.
an7.15:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:5.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
an7.15:5.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā vipassati viloketi.
an7.15:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patarati? 7.
an7.15:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:6.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti saki-d-eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karoti.
an7.15:6.7: Evam kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patarati.
an7.15:7.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti? 8.
an7.15:7.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:7.6: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti, tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an7.15:7.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā patigādhappatto hoti.
an7.15:8.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo? 9.
an7.15:8.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ummujjati ‘sādhu saddhā kusalesu dhammesu, sādhu hiri . . .
an7.15:8.6: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.15:8.7: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo ummujjitvā tiṇṇo hoti pāragato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo.
an7.15:9.1: Ime kho bhikkhave satta udakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 1.
